title: Spellforge Sorceress
description: A female sorceress with white hair in buns stands centrally on a stone platform, emitting swirling blue magical energy from her eyes and mouth. She is surrounded by three floating transparent orbs containing miniature scenes: a glowing waterfall, a running figure with lanterns, and a dark horned silhouette.
prompt: A mystical female sorceress with white hair in twin buns and glowing blue eyes stands on a stone platform in a dark void, blue magical energy flowing from her mouth and hands like liquid smoke. She wears detailed East Asian inspired armor. Three large transparent floating orbs surround her containing miniature glowing scenes: a waterfall with lanterns, a running figure with blue lanterns, and a dark horned blue figure. White line art with vibrant blue highlights on black background, magical atmosphere, detailed fantasy illustration.
